standard.summary: 开启后，uniform / targeted tag dropout 不会丢弃 keep_tokens 前缀。default-off，与旧 parity 兼容。
standard.effect: scope=all 时保护前 keep_tokens 个 tag；scope=after_separator 时 head 本就保护，此开关再保护 tail 的 keep_tokens 前缀。
standard.whenToUse: 触发词/主体必须出现、但仍要对后续 tag 做 dropout 时。
standard.avoidWhen: keep_tokens=0 或完全不需要保护前缀时保持关闭。

standard_en.summary: Once on, uniform and targeted tag dropout never drop the keep_tokens prefix. Off by default, compatible with the old parity behaviour.
standard_en.effect: With scope=all it protects the first keep_tokens tags; with scope=after_separator the head is protected anyway, and this switch additionally protects the tail's keep_tokens prefix.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the trigger word or subject must always appear but you still want dropout on the tags that follow.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave it off when keep_tokens=0 or the prefix needs no protection at all.

advanced.principle: keep_tokens 默认只影响 shuffle 前缀固定，不阻止 drop。本开关把 keep_tokens 前缀也排除在 dropout 之外。
advanced.intervention: dataset_loader 在 drop_tags / targeted / sFAD 路径传入 protect_prefix。
advanced.expectedImpact: 触发词更稳定，避免全丢导致空 caption。
advanced.tradeoffs: 降低 dropout 强度；需与 keep_tokens 配合。

advanced_en.principle: keep_tokens by default only pins the prefix against shuffle, not against drop. This switch also excludes the keep_tokens prefix from dropout.
advanced_en.intervention: dataset_loader passes protect_prefix on the drop_tags / targeted / sFAD paths.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Trigger words stay stable, avoiding empty captions from full drops.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Lowers dropout strength; needs to pair with keep_tokens.
